Current UI/UX Issue: Skeleton loading state flashes abruptly before static fallback loads

User Impact: Visual jarring flash between empty state and populated cards
Recommended Remediation: Add smooth CSS transition-opacity and min-height placeholder
Acceptance Criteria: Smooth cross-fade between skeleton and rendered flight cards

Current UI/UX Issue: Locale change does not reflect in translated strings instantly

User Impact: Only URL query string updates; Korean strings remain untranslated
Recommended Remediation: Integrate @nuxtjs/i18n with translation dictionaries for 5 locales
Acceptance Criteria: Switching language immediately translates all navigation and button labels

User Impact: Like state and count revert to original mock state
Recommended Remediation: Persist liked item IDs in localStorage or backend API
Acceptance Criteria: Liked moments remain toggled active across browser sessions
